title: Factual recall in linear associative memories: sharp asymptotics and mechanistic insights
abstract: arXiv:2605.10795v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models excel at factual recall, yet the fundamental limits of storing input--output associations with neural networks remain unclear. We study these limits in a minimal setting: a linear associative memory that maps $p$ input embeddings in $\mathbb{R}^d$ to their $d$-dimensional targets via a linear layer, requiring each mapped input to score its own target above all other outputs. Since all inputs compete for the same outputs, these constraints are strongly correlated, which makes the storage capacity $p_c$ --- the largest number of associations that can be stored --- hard to characterise. We address this in three steps. First, we introduce a decoupled model, in which each input competes with its own independent set of outputs, and provide numerical and analytical evidence that it is equivalent to the original model, both in capacity and in the structure of the learnt solution. translated_title: 线性联想记忆中的事实回忆：精确渐近分析与机理洞察
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在事实回忆方面表现出色，但神经网络存储输入-输出关联的基本极限仍不清楚。我们在一个最小化设置中研究这些极限：一个线性联想记忆，通过线性层将 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中的 $p$ 个输入嵌入映射到其 $d$ 维目标，要求每个映射后的输入对其自身目标的得分高于所有其他输出。由于所有输入都在竞争相同的输出，这些约束之间存在强相关性，这使得存储容量 $p_c$——即能够存储的最大关联数量——难以刻画。我们分三步解决这个问题。首先，我们引入一个解耦模型，其中每个输入与其自身独立的输出集合竞争，并提供数值和分析证据表明该模型在容量和学习解的结构上都与原始模型等价。其次，利用统计……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过引入一个与原模型等价的解耦模型，精确刻画了线性联想记忆在事实回忆任务中可存储关联数量的容量极限 $p_c$，并对学习解的结构给出了机理层面的洞察。
en_tdlr: By introducing an equivalent decoupled model, this paper sharply characterizes the storage capacity limits of linear associative memories for factual recall and provides mechanistic insights into the structure of the learned solution.
